configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server

configurationFields.label: Server MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets the server message of the day (MOTD), shown in server info and when joining a server

configurationFields.label: Server Hostname
configurationFields.description: Sets the server hostname

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server

configurationFields.label: Register Server Publicly
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be registered with the master server for public listing

configurationFields.label: Skill Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the skill level shown in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Client Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of clients that can be connected to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Client Limit Per IP
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of clients with the same IP that can connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Player Slots
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of client slots to reserve for players

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to access the remote console. Empty = RCON disabled

configurationFields.label: RCON Moderator Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the remote console password for moderators (limited access)

configurationFields.label: RCON Ban Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time a client gets banned for if remote console authentication fails. 0 = just use kick

configurationFields.label: RCON Maximum Tries
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of tries for remote console authentication

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Demo Recording
configurationFields.description: If set, demos will be automatically recorded

configurationFields.label: Maximum Auto Demo Recordings
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of automatically recorded demos. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Enable High Bandwidth Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will use high bandwidth mode. Doubles the bandwidth required for the server. LAN use only

configurationFields.label: Inactive Kick Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets how to deal with inactive clients

options.2: Move to free spectator slot, otherwise kick

configurationFields.label: Kick Inactive Spectators
configurationFields.description: If set, inactive spectators will be kicked

configurationFields.label: Inactive Kick Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time to wait before taking care of inactive clients

configurationFields.label: Map Download Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of map data packages a client gets on each request

configurationFields.label: Silent Spectator Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, join/leave messages for spectators will be muted

configurationFields.label: Enable Spam Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, spam protection will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Console Output Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the output level for messages in the console

configurationFields.label: External Console Ban Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time for which a client gets banned if external console authentication fails. 0 = connection just closed

configurationFields.label: External Console Auth Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the before the external console authentication times out

configurationFields.label: External Console Output Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the output level for information in the external console

configurationFields.label: Log File Timestamp
configurationFields.description: If set, a time stamp will be added to the server's log file name ('user/dumps/log.txt'), meaning the file won't be overwritten on each start. The server's logs are separate to GSCS's logs, which are not overwritten

configurationFields.label: Abort TCP Connection On Close
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will abort the TCP connection on close

configurationFields.label: Game Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the game type. The map must be reloaded for any change to take effect

configurationFields.label: Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to use on the server. If 'Custom' is selected, set Custom Map accordingly

configurationFields.label: Custom Map
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map to use for the Map, if 'Custom' is selected

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation List
configurationFields.description: Sets the maps to rotate between

configurationFields.label: Match Countdown
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of seconds to freeze the game in a countdown before the match starts. 0 = enabled only for survival gamemodes, -1 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Matches Per Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of matches on each map before rotating

configurationFields.label: Swap Teams Between Matches
configurationFields.description: If set, teams will be swapped between matches

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Ready Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, players can pause/unpause the game and start the game on warmup via their ready state

configurationFields.label: Warmup Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the warmup time before a match starts. 0 = disabled. -1 = all players ready

configurationFields.label: Allow Powerups
configurationFields.description: If set, powerups like ninja will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Respawn Delay (TDM)
configurationFields.description: Sets the time needed to respawn after death in the Team Deathmatch gametype

configurationFields.label: Score Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the score limit for the game. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the time limit for the game (in case of equal points there will be sudden death). 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Strict Spectator Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, information like health, ammo and armour will be restricted in spectator mode

configurationFields.label: Team Auto Balance Delay
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait before autobalancing teams

configurationFields.label: Enable Team Damage
configurationFields.description: If set, team damage will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Tournament Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the tournament mode. When enabled, players join the server as spectators

configurationFields.label: Allow Vote Kick
configurationFields.description: If set, voting to kick players will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Vote Kick Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of players required to start a kick vote

configurationFields.label: Vote Kick Ban Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time to ban a player if kicked by vote. 0 = just use kick

configurationFields.label: Allow Spectator Move Voting
configurationFields.description: If set, voting to move players to spectators will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Spectator Move Rejoin Delay
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait before a player can rejoin after being moved to spectator by vote
